description: SPF record checker (10-lookup limit) — Resolves a domain's SPF record and walks every include: and redirect= recursively over DNS-over-HTTPS to count DNS lookups against the RFC 7208 limit of 10 (over 10 = PermError, mail fails SPF). Flags multiple SPF records, includes with no SPF, void lookups, +all/?all, missing all, deprecated ptr, huge ip4 ranges, unknown terms. Returns verdict PASS/WARN/PERMERROR/FAIL, policy (-all strict, ~all softfail...), lookups used and remaining, every include with its own lookup cost, flattened ip4/ip6 lists and the full include tree. Pass domain= (an email address also works). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: email_spf_check
